name: Campingplatz Fohnsee 2
beschreibung: The Campingplatz Cohnsee 2 is located near Tirol and offers direct access to the lake. The site is designed in a natural style and is suitable for families and nature lovers. Guests will find pitches for tents, caravans and motorhomes here. Sanitary facilities and a small kiosk are available. The campsite offers a quiet atmosphere away from larger tourist centers.
